actions.name: Remove Windows Widgets
actions.description: Choose the installed Widgets packages, review their official removers, then review leftover files separately.

actions.name: Remove Copilot apps
actions.description: Review removable Copilot and Office Hub packages. Windows-protected components retain their protection; their available feature and policy settings are separate controls.

actions.name: Remove Microsoft Edge
actions.description: Use the installed version's registered remover. Review profile data separately instead of forcing profile deletion.

actions.name: Remove OneDrive
actions.description: Use the registered OneDrive remover and review leftovers. Synced personal files are not part of automatic app removal.

actions.name: System Protection and restore points
actions.description: Open Windows System Protection to inspect each volume, change protection or create a restore point. Erased restore points cannot be recreated from a settings backup.

actions.name: Manage BitLocker
actions.description: Use Windows' encryption flow to review the drive and its recovery-key requirements before encryption or decryption.

actions.name: Disk Cleanup
actions.description: Review cleanup categories in Windows Disk Cleanup. Deleting component-store backups or personal temporary files is a separate data-deletion action, not a reversible settings profile.

actions.name: O&O ShutUp10
actions.description: Open the existing O&O tool entry. This launcher is not counted as another optimization.

actions.name: Import WPD custom switches
actions.description: Import registry, policy, service and scheduled-task definitions into the shared catalog. Review selections before applying.

actions.name: Review file ownership
actions.description: Review ownership and a non-inheriting Full Control permission for one selected file or folder. Restore uses the captured owner and permissions.

actions.name: Create a Windows restore point
actions.description: Create and verify a new Windows restore point. An optional temporary frequency override is restored after the request.

actions.name: Delete Recall snapshots
actions.description: Open Windows Privacy settings and guide deletion in Recall & snapshots. Windows handles the deletion and any Windows Hello confirmation.

actions.name: File Explorer folder options
actions.description: Open File Explorer folder options. Saved-view resets are separate from restoring the catalog preference.

actions.name: Remove installed apps
actions.description: Review exact installed registrations for this user or another Windows account. Removing a registration does not remove provisioned packages for future accounts.
